name: com.engicor/agent-door
title: ENGICOR — wholesale used engines
description: Wholesale used engines (UAE/Guangzhou): search stock, prices, terms, price orders, request quotes.

tools.name: search_stock
tools.description: Search ENGICOR's used-engine warehouse list (Guangzhou, ~488 engine/gearbox families, 38 makes) by engine code, vehicle model or make. Returns specs, typical vehicles, configurations held, and the wholesale list price where published (FOB Guangzhou, USD per unit). Wholesale only.

query.description: Engine code, vehicle or words, e.g. "2TR", "Hilux", "Corolla 1.5", "Nissan 1.6"

priced_only.description: Only models with a published price

tools.name: get_engine
tools.description: Full detail of one engine family by code (e.g. "1NZ-FE", "QR25DE", "2TR-FE"): spec, typical vehicles, configurations held, list price and gearbox options if published, page and photo URLs.

tools.name: get_price_list
tools.description: The models with a published wholesale list price (USD per unit, FOB Guangzhou, Grade A used engines) and their gearbox options. Same price for first orders and full containers.

tools.name: get_terms
tools.description: ENGICOR's trade terms: what is sold and how engines are checked, order formats and minimums, payment (30% / 70%, T/T), what is not covered, warranty, markets served, inspection visit, contacts.

tools.name: estimate_order
tools.description: Validate an order against ENGICOR's order formats and compute the FOB total and the 30/70 payment split at published list prices. Nothing is registered.

order_type.description: first_order = new customer, 20/30/40 engines (+ optional gearboxes), LCL. container_20ft = 90 engines or 45+45 gearboxes. container_40ft = 130 engines or 65+65.

lines.description: Engine codes (e.g. "1NZ-FE", "HR16DE") and gearbox SKUs (e.g. "TR-HR16DE-CVT") with quantities.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Register a quotation request with ENGICOR on behalf of the buyer. Priced models get an estimated FOB quotation (valid 14 days) with a reference and a quotation link; models without a published price are registered for manual pricing. A human sales person confirms availability and sends the written Proforma Invoice within one business day. Nothing is payable or binding at this step. It registers the buyer's contact details with ENGICOR.

order_type.description: first_order = new customer, 20/30/40 engines (+ optional gearboxes), LCL. container_20ft = 90 engines or 45+45 gearboxes. container_40ft = 130 engines or 65+65.

lines.description: Engine codes (e.g. "1NZ-FE", "HR16DE") and gearbox SKUs (e.g. "TR-HR16DE-CVT") with quantities.

buyer.description: The buyer ENGICOR will send the Proforma Invoice to. Give email or phone.

phone.description: Phone or WhatsApp with country code, e.g. +234 803 000 0000

purchase_preference.description: remote = buy with photos/video; visit = Guangzhou Inspection Day; help = help me choose
